title: Abajulirwa Abanywevu
intro: Teebereza ekiseera enzikiriza we yagezeseddwa omuliro, era okukkiriza okutakyukakyuka kwe kwafuuka okujeemera okusembayo. Oweebwa omulimu gw’okubikkula ebikwata ku kibinja emboozi yaakyo eyogerwako mu Quran, ennyiriri z’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi okulwanyisa obutyobooli obusukkiridde. Sumulula obukodyo okuzuula emyoyo gino gye gyali, n’embeera ez’enjawulo ze zaayolekagana nazo.
clues: Twayimirira nga tuli banywevu mu kukkiriza kwaffe, wadde nga twapikirizibwa nnyo okwerekereza okukkiriza kwaffe.
Twatunuulirwa omufuzi ow’amaanyi eyafuba okuzikiza ekitangaala ky’okukkiriza Katonda omu.
Twalaba obubonero obw’amaanyi n’ebyamagero, naye ate abatunyigiriza baasigala nga tebafaayo.
Twagumira enkola ey’entiisa ey’okuyigganyizibwa eyategekebwa okutiisa abalala ne bagondera.
Twasuulibwa mu muliro ogw’omuliro ogwaka, naye ate obugumu bwaffe bwatufunira ekifo ekigulumivu eri Allah.
Emboozi yaffe eyogerwako mu Surah eyatuumibwa erinnya ly’emmunyeenye ez’omu ggulu, ng’erabula ku nkomerero y’abo abayigganya abakkiriza.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
